messages:
maya: hey team — heads up, preview build for the quickstart (hello-mini) failed after my docs PR. Failing in CI step that lints the sample app. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 :grimacing:

docs-bot: build failed on branch docs/quickstart-refresh (job: sample-lint). log: https://ci.redwood.ai/342340/log/88

devon: on it. can you paste the failing error? I suspect the `AUTH_TOKEN` var name changed in SDK8 quickstart.

maya: error: env var AUTH_TOKEN not set
stack: ./scripts/start.sh: line 12: echo $AUTH_TOKEN
I updated snippets to SDK8 but missed the env var note.

samir: small fix: change start.sh to default to env var fallback. push a patch?

devon: i'll open a tiny PR to the sample app in the docs repo. patch: ```diff
- echo $AUTH_TOKEN
+ echo ${AUTH_TOKEN:-"<set REDWOOD_API_KEY>"}
``` will avoid CI failure.

alex: :eyes: can we also add a CI lint exception for the sample app until the snippet migration PR merges? otherwise preview will keep failing.

olivia: prefer not to weaken lint. devon — can you land the quick PR this morning and tag me for review? i'll do the merge and trigger the preview again.

devon: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423 — tiny change + test. cc @olivia

docs-bot: PR #8423 build: success (sample-lint) — preview link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-mini

maya: :tada: preview looks green. thanks all. note for follow-up: add short note in quickstart auth section about SDK8 ENV names.
